pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of averaging down or scaling into losing positions; additions are only permitted when existing open positions are in profit by at least 2.5x the dollar risk.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order execution during 5-minute ATR expansions exceeding 3.5x the 20-period moving average unless confirmed by a Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP) retest.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate trailing profit locks at +$10.00 and execute hard capital protection stops once floating profit hits +$15.00.
